content: पङ्क्तिः {%f.%} [पञ्च् विस्तारे क्तिन्] .²1 A line, row, range, series; दृश्येत चारुपदपङ्क्तिरलक्तकाङ्का <ls>V. 4. 16</ls>; पक्ष्मपङ्क्तिः <ls>R. 2. 19</ls>; अलिपङ्क्तिः <ls>Ku. 4. 15</ls>; सहस्रधात्मा व्यरुचाद्विभक्त पयोमुचां पङ्क्तिषु विद्युतेव <ls>R. 6. 5</ls>. .²2 A group, collection, flock, troop. .²3 A row of people (of the same caste) sitting down to a meal, a company or party at dinner of the same caste; <ab>cf.</ab> पङ्क्तिपावन below. .²4 The living generation. .²5 The earth. .²6 Fame, celebrity. .²7 A collection of five, or the number ‘five’. .²8 The number ‘ten’ as in पङ्क्तिरथ, पङ्क्तिग्रीव. .²9 Cooking; maturing, .²10 A company of persons of the same tribe. .²11 A sort of fivefold metre.
